name: David Trias
summary: David Trias is the Forsaken rogue trainer stationed in Deathknell. He instructs freshly awakened undead in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft to aid Queen Sylvanas and the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Guide from the Shadows
sections.body: Positioned amidst the tombstones and ruins of Deathknell, David Trias is tasked with identifying and training those newly risen undead who possess a talent for unseen murder. For the fledgling Forsaken, survival requires more than sheer force of arms; it demands precise strikes from the dark. Trias decrypts orders and teaches initiates how to wield daggers, conceal their movements, and turn their reanimated reflexes into lethal precision against the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: A Familiar Name
sections.body: The surname Trias carries peculiar echoes across the continent. Far to the south in the kingdom of Stormwind sits Elling Trias, a well-known cheese merchant who secretly maintains deep ties to master rogues and spymasters. David and Elling share a surname, but no family connection between them is confirmed.

faq.answer: David Trias is a Forsaken rogue trainer found in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He teaches newly awakened Forsaken rogues their initial combat techniques and delivers their first covert assignments.

faq.q: Where can I find David Trias?
faq.answer: He is located in Deathknell, the starting village for the Forsaken in Tirisfal Glades, standing near the settlement's structures and assisting newly risen undead.

faq.q: Is David Trias related to Elling Trias in Stormwind?
aliases: is he related to elling trias
faq.answer: He shares his surname with Elling Trias of Stormwind, but no family connection is confirmed.

faq.q: What role does he play in Forsaken training?
faq.answer: Initiate rogues emerging from Deathknell's crypt are directed to David Trias with an encrypted scroll. He deciphers their instructions, guides their foundational training, and sets them on the path to becoming stealth operatives for the Forsaken.

angles.text: For Forsaken rogues, David Trias is your very first mentor, helping you decipher secret scrolls and teaching you how to turn the cold precision of undeath into lethal bladecraft.
David Trias represents the grim reality of the Forsaken: former humans of Lordaeron whose past lives and lineage are severed by the plague, redirected now into serving Queen Sylvanas.
